name: Bumblebee poison dart frog
desc: A small yellow-and-black frog of the Gran Sabana region that eats tiny insects, especially ants, on the forest floor.
about: The yellow-banded poison dart frog, also known as yellow-headed poison dart frog or bumblebee poison frog, is a poison dart frog from the genus Dendrobates of the family Dendrobatidae.
